---
title: "Organic Alignment"
description: "Organic alignment occurs when individuals or groups independently adopt narratives that align with a regime's goals, driven by shared ideology, grievances, or opportunism, thereby enhancing the regime's narrative credibility."
categories: ["Spillover"]
---


::: {.protected-content}

::: {.function-badge}
[Spillover](../function/spillover.qmd)
:::

Individuals, influencers, or organizations independently adopt positions or narratives that coincide with a regime’s objectives without coordination or payment. Alignment arises through ideology, grievance resonance, or opportunism, giving state-driven narratives authentic social traction.

:::
